commits.title: Route load: one import walker, and a graph test that holds what each server entry reaches

changes.how: Plain Node ESM, no dependency, in the style of scripts/lib/ratchet-count.mjs. Step 0.1's docs/audits/bloat-review-2026-11/scripts/import-reach.mjs is the review's own walker and stays as the record of how the review counted; compare your first numbers with it (node docs/audits/bloat-review-2026-11/scripts/import-reach.mjs src/app/api/visit/route.ts) and expect the same count within a few files. Move these out of src/lib/pay-routes.graph.test.ts, with the same behaviour: the IMPORT regular expression, typesOnly(clause), importsOf(text) and resolve(from, specifier). Give each a first argument or an options object instead of the test's module constants: importsOf(text, { dynamic }) returns the specifiers of value imports and re-exports; with dynamic false it leaves out the import('...') form (match group 4 of IMPORT). resolve(srcDir, from, specifier) resolves '@/x' against srcDir and './x' against the importing file, trying the same five candidates as today (x, x.ts, x.tsx, x/index.ts, x/index.tsx), and returns null for a package. Add packageOf(specifier): the package name of a bare specifier ('stripe', '@supabase/supabase-js'), null for '@/' and '.' specifiers and for 'node:' builtins. Export reach(srcDir, entry, { dynamic = true, stop = () => false, clientLeaf = false }): the Map of every file reached (file to the file that imported it), the entry included; with clientLeaf true a file whose first 300 characters hold a 'use client' directive is recorded but its imports are not followed. Export packagesReached(srcDir, entry, options): the Set of package names imported by any file that reach() returns. Export sourceFiles(dir): every .ts and .tsx file under dir that is not a *.test.* file. Export largestCycle(srcDir, files, { dynamic = false }): Tarjan's strongly connected components over the given files with edges from importsOf and resolve; return { size, files } of the largest component (size 1 means no cycle). No function reads process.cwd(): the caller passes the folder.

Delete the local IMPORT, typesOnly(), importsOf(), resolve() and reach() (lines 16 to 73 today) and import them from '../../scripts/lib/import-walk.mjs', as src/server/ratchet.scan.test.ts imports ratchet-count.mjs. Keep the file's own SRC, MARKET, sources() and rel(). Where the test called reach(entry, stop), call reach(SRC, entry, { dynamic: true, stop }) so it still follows import(), and where it called resolve(from, spec) or importsOf(text), pass SRC and { dynamic: true }. Change no expectation and no test name: every test of the file must pass with the same assertions.

Export ENTRIES: an object from a short name to a repo-relative file. Exactly these: proxy src/proxy.ts; start-hook src/instrumentation.ts; health src/app/api/health/route.ts; beacon-visit src/app/api/visit/route.ts; beacon-touch src/app/api/visit/touch/route.ts; beacon-speed src/app/api/visit/speed/route.ts; beacon-own-speed src/app/api/visit/speed/own/route.ts; beacon-recommendation-events src/app/api/recommendations/events/route.ts; shop-tiles src/app/api/shop/tiles/route.ts; store-layout src/app/s/[store]/[market]/layout.tsx; store-home src/app/s/[store]/[market]/page.tsx; store-product src/app/s/[store]/[market]/p/[handle]/page.tsx; admin-store-layout src/app/admin/(gated)/[store]/layout.tsx; admin-orders src/app/admin/(gated)/[store]/orders/page.tsx; platform-admin-layout src/app/admin/(gated)/platform/layout.tsx; platform-admin-home src/app/admin/(gated)/platform/page.tsx; site-front-page src/app/(platform)/page.tsx; docs-feedback src/app/api/docs/feedback/route.ts. Export FORBIDDEN: for each entry a list of repo-relative modules and package names it may not reach by static value imports. The five beacons, health and shop-tiles: src/server/chat-route.ts, src/server/chat-agent.ts, src/server/auth.ts, src/server/owner-tools.ts, src/server/owner-assistant.ts, src/server/dream-factory.ts, src/lib/admin-text.ts, any file under src/lib/admin-messages/, src/db/schema.ts, and the packages stripe, sharp, opentype.js, @supabase/supabase-js, playwright-core; health also src/server/stores.ts. proxy and start-hook: src/server/auth.ts, src/server/pages.ts, src/server/seo.ts, src/server/ai.ts, src/lib/admin-text.ts, any file under src/lib/admin-messages/, src/db/schema.ts, src/server/owner-tools.ts, src/server/owner-assistant.ts, src/server/dream-factory.ts, playwright-core. store-layout, store-home, store-product: src/server/owner-tools.ts, src/server/owner-assistant.ts, src/server/privacy-erasure.ts, src/server/retention.ts, src/server/theme-store.ts, src/server/dream-factory.ts, src/lib/admin-text.ts, sharp, playwright-core. admin-store-layout, admin-orders, platform-admin-layout, platform-admin-home: src/server/owner-assistant.ts, src/server/owner-tools.ts, src/lib/owner-tools.ts. site-front-page and docs-feedback: src/server/owner-tools.ts, src/server/owner-assistant.ts, src/server/dream-factory.ts. Export routeLoadCounts(root): using import-walk.mjs with { dynamic: false, clientLeaf: true } it returns { largestCycle (the size among sourceFiles of src/server), entries: { name: files reached }, exceptions: { name: sorted list of the FORBIDDEN items that entry reaches today }, handlers: { repo-relative route.ts path: files reached } for every route.ts under src/app whose count is over 1,500 }.

The twin of scripts/ratchet.mjs for src/server/route-load.baseline.json. It prints each entry's count, the largest cycle and each entry's exceptions. With --write it writes the baseline but refuses, as scripts/ratchet.mjs does (print the lines, exit 1, write nothing), when an entry's count or the cycle is higher than the stored one, when an entry has an exception that the stored list lacks, or when a handler over 1,500 is new; --first writes whatever is there (use it once, for the first baseline). When it writes, it keeps the 'reason' text of each handler already in the file and writes 'reason: TODO' for a new one, and it exits 1 if any reason is still TODO.

Made by 'node scripts/route-load.mjs --first', never by hand. Shape: { largestCycle: number, entries: { name: number }, exceptions: { name: [strings] }, heavyHandlers: { path: { files: number, reason: string } } }. After the first write, replace every 'TODO' reason by hand with one short sentence that says why that handler loads over 1,500 files today; where you do not know, write 'reaches the shared server cycle through <the first import that leads there>' (the script's printed chain tells you which). Expect about 181 handlers if step 0.6 has not landed and about 29 if it has.

A vitest file modelled on src/server/ratchet.scan.test.ts. It calls routeLoadCounts(process.cwd()) once and has these tests. (1) 'no entry reaches more files': each entry's count is at most its baseline; the message names the entry, both numbers and says 'import the helper from the file that defines it, or load the module with import() where it is used'. (2) 'the largest import cycle in src/server does not grow'. (3) 'no entry reaches a forbidden module': the items of FORBIDDEN an entry reaches are all in the baseline's exceptions for it; the message names the entry, the module and the chain of imports from the entry to it (walk the Map that reach() returns back to the entry). (4) 'every handler over 1,500 files is on the named list with a reason': no route.ts over 1,500 is missing from heavyHandlers, and no reason is empty or TODO. (5) 'the baseline is as low as the code': fails when a count or the cycle is lower than the baseline, when a stored exception is no longer reached, or when a listed handler is at 1,500 or under; the message says 'run node scripts/route-load.mjs --write'. (6) 'the walker would notice': with a temporary folder (mkdtempSync) holding three small files where a.ts imports b.ts, b.ts imports c.ts with 'import type', and c.ts imports a.ts, reach() from a.ts returns 2 files with dynamic false, and largestCycle() returns size 1; then with a value import in b.ts it returns 3 files and a cycle of 3. (7) 'the proxy and the beacons reach no admin catalogue': for proxy and the five beacons, no reached file is under src/lib/admin-messages/, unless the baseline's exceptions list it.

changes.how: Plain Node, no dependency. commits.title: Route budget: CI holds chunk bytes per kind of entry, the server-reference manifest, the routing rules and cold-load medians

changes.how: Plain Node, run after pnpm build from the repo root. Part A, chunk bytes: for each route in .next/app-path-routes-manifest.json read its built entry file under .next/server/app (page.js or route.js), collect the chunk paths it loads at start (the strings passed to R.c("...") in the entry; read the entry of /api/health first to confirm the form this Next version writes, and stop if it is not R.c), and sum the bytes of those files. Group routes into kinds by path: beacon (/api/visit, /api/visit/touch, /api/visit/speed, /api/visit/speed/own, /api/recommendations/events), api (other /api), store (/s/[store]/[market] and below, except cart, checkout and account), pay (cart, checkout, account), site (the (platform) and (docs) groups), admin-store (/admin/(gated)/[store]/...), admin-platform (/admin/(gated)/platform/...), and the proxy and src/instrumentation's built file (.next/server/instrumentation.js) as kinds of their own. Hold the largest route of each kind, not a sample. Part B, the manifest: bytes of .next/server/server-reference-manifest.json, its number of entries, entries per route (median, and the median for admin routes and for the five beacons), and the milliseconds to load it, median of five, from docs/audits/bloat-review-2026-11/scripts/manifest-time.cjs run in a fresh process (this stands for Next's 'load route manifests' step, which production cannot time). Part C: the bytes of server chunk files whose content hash repeats (group files under .next/server/chunks by sha1), printed only. Part D: the number of routing rules: read .next/routes-manifest.json and add the lengths of headers, redirects, rewrites (beforeFiles, afterFiles and fallback, or the array), dynamicRoutes and staticRoutes; fail above 1,600 (Vercel's cap is 2,048). Part E, cold load: for /api/health, /api/visit, the proxy, the start hook, the store home, the product page and the admin's orders page, run step 0.1's cold-load scripts in a fresh process (child_process.spawnSync of node) five times each and take the median milliseconds: docs/audits/bloat-review-2026-11/scripts/cold-load-route.cjs <built route.js> for /api/health and /api/visit, cold-load-proxy.cjs for the proxy, cold-load-start-hook.cjs for the start hook, and cold-load-page.cjs for the three pages (read each script's first lines for its arguments and what it prints); print each median and its distance from /api/health's. Part F: run docs/audits/bloat-review-2026-11/scripts/words-in-entries.mjs and fail when an entry outside /admin lists a chunk that holds a sentence of src/lib/admin-messages/builder.nb.ts; and sum the bytes of the files under src/lib/messages that the store layout reaches (reach() of scripts/lib/import-walk.mjs from src/app/s/[store]/[market]/layout.tsx, dynamic false, clientLeaf true) and fail above 590,000. Budgets live in scripts/route-budget.json: chunk bytes per kind at today's figure plus 4%; manifest bytes and entries at today's figures exactly (they may not rise); cold-load distance per entry at its first measured figure plus 25% (timings are noisy on a shared runner: when one is over, rerun that entry's five runs once before failing). With --write the script lowers figures and refuses to raise them unless --first. Print everything as Markdown tables. Exit 1 with one line per breach that names the entry, the figure, the budget and what to do.

Written by 'pnpm build && node scripts/route-budget.mjs --write --first'. Shape: { chunkBytes: { kind: { route, bytes, max } }, manifest: { bytes, entries }, routingRules: { max: 1600 }, coldMs: { entry: { firstFigure, max } }, coldBarMs: { beacon: 100, proxy: 100, storePage: 300, adminPage: 450 }, storefrontMessagesBytes: { max: 590000 } }. coldBarMs is printed beside each median as 'bar' and is not enforced yet: the comment field 'coldBarFrom' says 'enforced when phase 2 is in (steps 2.20 to 2.24)'.
